amount_phrase: the Desk plans to purchase Treasury bills at an initial pace of approximately $60 billion per month
note: Reserve management purchases of bills. The Desk's statement gives no time, so the row is read from the end of the day; the Board's statement of 11:00 names no amount. Reinvestment purchases are reserve-neutral and enter at 0.

amount_phrase: by at least $500 billion and by at least $200 billion
note: Purchases of at least $500 billion of Treasury securities and $200 billion of agency MBS over coming months, with no monthly amount. Replaces the reserve management plan.

amount_phrase: in the amounts needed to support smooth market functioning
note: Purchases without a limit. The table needs an effective date after the announcement day, so the row takes effect the next day; the value of the day before is also unquantified.

note: Net additions to holdings at the current pace. The Desk's statement gives no time, so the row is read from the end of the day. The September and December 2020 statements keep the pace and add no row.
